name: Pharvaris Phase III momentum
summary: Multiple signals this month suggest Pharvaris is accelerating toward a Phase III readout for deucrictibant. New site activations, an abstract at EAACI, and updated investor guidance all point to a Q4 2025 data readout becoming more likely. This is the most time-sensitive competitive development to monitor.

name: Oral HAE market shaping up
summary: BioCryst and Pharvaris are both making moves that will define the oral HAE treatment narrative ahead of Sebetralstat's anticipated launch. BioCryst's new real-world evidence publication and Pharvaris's updated efficacy messaging collectively raise the evidentiary bar Pharma Inc will need to clear.

name: Takeda defending prophylaxis franchise
summary: Takeda has published new long-term registry data and increased its congress presence in Europe this quarter. The pattern is consistent with a defensive strategy to reinforce Takhzyro's position as standard of care before oral entrants reach the market.

name: Regulatory calendar — near-term decisions
summary: Two regulatory milestones in the next 90 days are relevant to Pharma Inc's launch planning: the EMA CHMP opinion on garadacimab (CSL Behring) and a NICE appraisal update for berotralstat. Outcomes will influence payer and physician expectations for the oral HAE class.

name: KOL activity at upcoming congresses
summary: Three HAE-focused KOLs with known relationships to Pharvaris and BioCryst are listed as speakers at ACAAI next month. Their presentation abstracts are now public and contain early signals about how the medical community is framing the evolving treatment landscape.
